title: MQTT from first principles
summary: Configure MQTT, understand topics and payloads, and build command and notification flows.
body:
Terms

A broker routes messages. A client publishes a payload to a topic or subscribes to receive it. Retained messages store the latest payload for new subscribers. QoS 1 requests at-least-once delivery and can duplicate a message.

Configuration

FieldMeaning
Host / portBroker address and TCP port; default 1883.
Username/passwordCredentials when required.
Client IDConfigured base; firmware adds a MAC-derived suffix.
Base topicRoot such as elma/greenhouse.
DiscoveryPublish supported Home Assistant entities.

Implemented topic families

<base>/availability
<base>/state/cpu_temperature
<base>/state/volume
<base>/state/battery_voltage
<base>/state/battery_percent
<base>/state/battery_charging
<base>/cmd/play, /cmd/tts, /cmd/stop, /cmd/volume
<base>/cmd/reboot, /cmd/web_ui
<base>/cmd/ota/check, /cmd/ota/install
<base>/cmd/motor/channel_a/open (plus close/switch/duration)

Feature-specific subscriptions exist only when that feature is compiled. Motor channel B mirrors A.

Command payloads

CommandAccepted payload
volumeInteger percent, fractional level, or JSON containing volumePercent/volume/volume_level.
alarmstop/off/0 stops; other payload starts.
web_uiunlock/on/start/enable unlocks; other values lock.
ota/installempty/install, latest, version text, or JSON version/tag and optional asset.
motor switchON/OPEN or OFF/CLOSE.
motor durationDuration parsed and clamped by the motor runtime.
play/ttsURL/text or JSON media description; requires compiled audio.

Periodic telemetry

On Start → Timer (5 s) → MQTT Publish In
Temperature → MQTT Publish Append value
Topic: elma/greenhouse/temperature
Text: Greenhouse temperature:

A Delay does not self-trigger; Timer supplies periodic Flow. Publish requires an exact topic without + or #, uses QoS 1, and Out means queued rather than broker-acknowledged.

Notifications

ELMA-IoT publishes events; it does not directly create a phone notification. Home Assistant or another subscriber must turn the event into one.

title: Home Assistant and MQTT Discovery
summary: Expose supported features as one device with multiple Home Assistant entities.
body:
Discovery model

When discovery is enabled and MQTT connects, firmware publishes retained discovery records for features included in the build. Entities share device identity, so Home Assistant groups them as one physical device.

Current entity sources

Depending on compiled features: availability, CPU temperature, battery voltage/percentage/charging, volume/audio commands, alarm/notification controls, storage actions, OTA actions, and configured DRV8833 channels. Configuration-only profiles do not automatically become entities.

Example device

A “Greenhouse Controller” may contain temperature, battery, relay/fan, display, and MQTT status. Only capabilities backed by compiled runtime code appear. Unsupported profiles need a future/custom driver.

Missing entity

  1. Confirm MQTT Connected.
  2. Confirm discovery is enabled.
  3. Confirm the feature is compiled and runtime-supported.
  4. Republish discovery.
  5. Inspect retained discovery topics and logs.

Effects

Each file field is text and defaults empty. Volume defaults to 100%, except ambientSoundVolumePercent at 20%: startupFile/startupVolumePercent, alarmFile/alarmVolumePercent, notificationFile/notificationVolumePercent, ambientSoundFile/ambientSoundVolumePercent, lowBatteryFile/lowBatteryVolumePercent, shutDownFile/shutDownVolumePercent, updateAvailableFile/updateAvailableVolumePercent, and updateSuccessFile/updateSuccessVolumePercent.

Application-managed fields

Language, theme, GPIO safety, selected board, diagram layout, bindings, profiles, melodies, motor runtime, and Logics graph should be edited through ELMA-IoT. Malformed internal JSON is normalized or rejected.
